question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **Extravagent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the given word is **Extravagant**__.
 
• The meaning of the given word is- __spending too much money, or using too much of something__.
 
• Let's see an example- *It was very **extravagant** of you to buy strawberries out of season.*

 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
